title: default charset applied when Content-Type present but no charset param
description: parse.rs build_part: the no_content_type flag triggers only when content_type() is None. RFC 2045 §5.2 specifies charset=us-ascii only when Content-Type is entirely absent. If Content-Type is present without a charset attribute (e.g. 'text/plain' with no params), no_content_type=false, so charset is None. The decode_body_value fall-through then uses 'utf-8' as the default in decode.rs line 130. This diverges from RFC 2045 §5.2 which says the default charset for text/* is us-ascii, not utf-8, when content-type is present but charset is omitted.
close_reason: Intentional deviation from RFC 2045 §5.2 (us-ascii default) documented at the unwrap_or line; UTF-8 default avoids false is_encoding_problem flags on modern charsetless text.
